text:
Priya Patel: Quick copy pass needed on the inline permission-denied help that appears in the console when a user hits a protected route. Screenshot attached -> https://redwood.screenshot/perm-deny.png
Ethan: Yep saw this in QA. Current copy says: "You don't have permission to access this resource. Contact your admin." feels a little blunt.
Maya: Agreed. Also a11y: when this appears we should ensure focus moves into the flyout and an aria-live alert is announced.
Priya Patel: Good call on focus. Copy-wise looking for alternatives that are short and give a clear next step.
Ethan: Suggested variants (short):
- "Access denied — request access from your admin"
- "You don’t have access to this workspace. Request access"
Maya: Prefer phrasing that avoids passive voice and keeps CTA verb-first: "Request access" not "Contact your admin" (users might not know who admin is).
Alex (eng): Implementation note: the small flyout has only ~80px width on mobile; we need one-liners ideally. Also we have the blue request button already wired to the access-request endpoint.
Sam (DesignBot): Microcopy rules reminder: keep primary action label <= 2 words, avoid punctuation in short messages, and make error tone neutral. :gear:
Priya Patel: What about adding a tiny helper line for why (optional) — eg: "Request access — this dataset is restricted to org admins". Too wordy?
Maya: That's borderline long. Maybe show reason only if we have it. So default: "Access denied — Request access"; expanded: "Reason: restricted to org admins" as secondary line.
Ethan: Also consider screen-reader experience: announce both lines and include link text that says "Request access to workspace" (more descriptive than just "Request").
Priya Patel: Okay final pass for copy examples: put these in the thread and I’ll update the mock: 
```
Primary: "Access denied — Request access"
Action label: "Request access to workspace"
Secondary (optional): "Reason: restricted to org admins"
```
Maya: LGTM. Tiny nit: change em dash to colon on mobile? Not required but could help wrapping. Test with both.
Alex (eng): I'll check wrap behaviour and accessibility props tomorrow, will ping here if we need shorter variants.
Sam (DesignBot): Also flagged for localization: avoid contractions like "don’t" in error messages — we used "don’t" earlier; prefer "do not" in strings that are fed to i18n.
Priya Patel: Good catch — use full words in code strings. I'll update the mock and send a follow-up. Thanks all :heart:
Ethan: Thanks! :thumbsup:
Maya: sounds good :sparkles:
